title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Buying a Block of Prepaid Technician Hours
content:
## The request this covers

An owner holding a rate program under the Demand Service Rate Programs that sells prepaid hours may ask
to buy a block of technician hours on it.

A block of prepaid hours is priced only once the credit ceiling standing on the rate program carries a change dated in the current program year. The current program year runs from the day the current term started to the day of the
purchase.

## The effect on the program

One block purchase entry is opened on the rate program, carrying the hours bought, the day they were
bought and the price paid. The hours are credited to the program's prepaid balance and can be drawn by
later calls, and the price stands as the amount for that purchase.

## Who runs it

This is the building owner's own act. The tool `purchase_hour_block_a465dc68` is unlocked and handed
over, and the customer themselves runs it; the desk states the rate program reference when handing it
over, and the hours and the price are worked out from the published terms and the records and passed in.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `program_id` | The reference number of the demand service rate program the hours are credited to, as the desk states it when handing this over. |
| `block_hours` | The quantity of prepaid technician hours bought, in decimal hours to 1 decimal place, never negative. |
| `purchase_amount_usd` | The price paid for the block, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent and never negative. |

## The receipt

One line of plain text comes back naming the reference number of the new block purchase entry, the hours
credited in decimal hours to 1 decimal place and the price in USD to 2 decimal places. The named
purchase entry reference is the receipt that the hours were credited.
